strings.name: Marta
strings.summary: Marta rose from northeastern Brazil to professional leagues in Sweden and the United States, becoming a leading figure through dribbling, creativity and goals. A six-time FIFA women’s world player, she scored 17 Women’s World Cup goals and shared three Olympic silvers with Brazil. She captained Orlando’s 2024 NWSL champions and scored twice in the 2025 Copa América final. Her contract expired after the 2026 season; her next club remained undecided.

strings.timeline.t7.title: World Cup final
